Subject: Re: Request for Recommendation Letter

Dear Prof. Zhang,

Thank you for letting me know. I understand how busy the semester can get, and I appreciate your willingness to support my application.

If there’s any additional information that would make the process easier for you—such as a brief summary of the project, a list of specific achievements, or a copy of the application portal link—please let me know. I’ll be happy to provide whatever you need at your convenience.

Thank you again for your time and support.

Best regards,  
Li Wei
